title: Offer pre-paid funeral contributions only as a registered fund
what: Carry on contributory funeral benefit business (funeral plans paid for by contributions) only as a funeral contribution fund under the Act.

sources.title: Funeral Funds Act 1979 (NSW)
sources.publisher: NSW Legislation (via the Open Australian Legal Corpus)
sources.quote: A person must not carry on or advertise that the person carries on or is willing to carry on any contributory funeral benefit business unless that person is a funeral contribution fund

administration.who: NSW Department of Customer Service (the Secretary)
